a.speaker: Thimbleberry Court
a.text:
The court is dark and full of people standing in driveways with candles. Ruth has {child.name} and {dog.name} on her porch, the way the rally card said: if no one is home, go to Ruth's.

{child.name} runs at you so hard you nearly go over.

check.speaker: Thimbleberry Court
check.text: {teen.name} isn't here. The school is two and a half miles. {elder.name} is in Forest Grove. {partner.name} is across the West Hills at the hill hospital.

tess_here.speaker: {teen.name}
tess_here.text: {teen.name} is sitting on the front step with a dead phone in both hands. "The card said come home. So I came home." The rally plan paid off before anything else did.
